condensation_time.limit: Requires high occupation, q much greater than one, kinetic evolution, and stated virial assumptions; not AeST
condensation_time.model: Kinetic gravitational condensation estimate in a specified boson model

late_annihilation.model: After inverse production is negligible, adiabatic entropy, only pair annihilation, no decays or fresh production

radiation_era_example.assumptions: Constant relativistic degrees of freedom and s-wave cross section; dY/dx proportional to -Y_plus Y_minus/x^2
radiation_era_example.lesson: Finite integrated exposure leaves a symmetric remnant; an exact conserved excess also sets a lower bound

one_wave_two_momenta.coarse_graining: Spatial averaging over many interference fringes removes the p=0 Wigner interference term
one_wave_two_momenta.lesson: Zero current does not imply zero momentum spread or zero kinetic energy
one_wave_two_momenta.model: Free standing wave, not AeST and not a collapse simulation

ordering_by_spectral_transport.lesson: An isolated whole system can order at low momentum by transferring energy outside that sector
ordering_by_spectral_transport.limit: No collision equation was solved; no mechanism, exponent or applicability to dark matter is established
ordering_by_spectral_transport.model: Assumed one-dimensional Gaussian scaling spectrum restricted to a moving low-momentum band

status: Illustrative analytical consequences with numerical checks; no observations or AeST nonlinear evolution
